title: ork run prompt tests catch swapped answers; help text says y/n
lead: From the S21 review. The prompt test gives both prompts the same answer, so swapped well-specified and split answers pass. The usage line and flag help still say yes|no although y and n are accepted (#87).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: From the S21 review. The prompt test gives both prompts the same answer, so swapped well-specified and split answers pass. The usage line and flag help still say yes|no although y and n are accepted (#87).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The test answers the two prompts differently and fails if they are swapped.
- Usage and flag help show y|n and yes|no.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Rewrite TestRunLineupPromptsTakeYAndN in internal/cli/run_test.go (:49-62). Today it sends the same answer to both prompts (:55), so swapped prompts pass. Use pairs of different answers for well-specified and split, for example {"y","n"}, {"n","y"}, {"Yes","NO"}, and expect well_specified and split to match each pair.
2. Run go test ./internal/cli -run TestRunLineupPromptsTakeYAndN. It passes before the change, so first check the test is strong: swap the two ask results in internal/cli/run.go (the well-specified ask near :86, the split ask near :92) and confirm the new test goes red. Restore.
3. Add TestRunUsageSaysYAndN in internal/cli/run_test.go: the usage error from an invalid --well-specified (run.go:55) and the top-level usage text (usageText, internal/cli/cli.go:42) both say y/n, and neither says yes|no.
4. Change the flag help at internal/cli/run.go:40-41 from "yes or no" to "y/n", and the usage error at run.go:55 from "yes|no" to "y/n".
5. Change the top-level usage line internal/cli/cli.go:42 from --well-specified yes|no --split yes|no to y/n. The item's Files list missed this file.
6. Do not change internal/slicercli/write.go:90-94. That call passes yes or no to slicer, which takes those words.
Open: none.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/cli
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check
- adj lint
- Run by name: TestRunLineupPromptsTakeYAndN, TestRunConfirmTakesYAndN, TestRunUsageSaysYAndN.
- Mutation: swap the two ask results in run.go and confirm TestRunLineupPromptsTakeYAndN goes red for the right reason (a wrong well_specified or split value).
